sources.title: | 26.12 | The Low Elo Players' Yone Guide |

passive.name: Way of the Hunter
passive.text: Yone deals magic damage with every second Attack. In addition, his critical strike chance is increased.

spells.name: Mortal Steel
spells.text: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne.

spells.name: Spirit Cleave
spells.text: Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone. Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit by the swipe.Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed.

spells.name: Soul Unbound
spells.text: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.

spells.name: Fate Sealed
spells.text: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.

damage.value: Yone deals sustained magic damage with every second Attack.

winCondition.value: Yone wins by farming steadily and scaling into the later game.

spikes.why: Yone gets much stronger after his weak early game and can become difficult to stop.
Yone scales well because almost every item is a power spike for him.
Yone's next Mortal Steel can dash forward and knock enemies Airborne.

mistakes.value: Yone cannot remain away from his body after Soul Unbound ends, because his spirit is forced back.
